params.prompt: A 2023 small-business website built on a typical website-builder template (Tilda / Wix style): clean flat design, white background, thin top navbar with logo «Студия» and menu «Услуги · Портфолио · Цены · Контакты» and a rounded pill button «Оставить заявку», a large stock-photo hero of a smiling team at laptops in a bright office with headline «Создаём сайты для вашего бизнеса», a row of three rounded feature cards with generic line icons, pastel blue accent color, standard sans-serif font, a simple footer. Neat but generic template look, nothing special. Flat, straight-on full-page screenshot of the web page only: no browser window, no monitor, no device, no hands, no perspective, fills the whole frame edge to edge. Crisp and legible. No real brand logos, no watermark.
